statement: Sotto: YouTube captions in sync (right display at the right time, pause at the right time) and real-time local transcription on the same overlay, with no bugs -- owner: 'i want sotto to be fucking finished and with no bugs'
charter: MULTI-DAY EXECUTION CHARTER: Never doubt yourself or declare the mission impossible. It is ALWAYS possible to achieve this goal — when blocked, shift angles, invent a tool or offline twin, decompose into smaller verifiable slices, snapshot with git, and keep advancing continuously across sessions until 100% of acceptance criteria carry real receipts.
